chunks: Suppress anger, and forgive when you have power (to punish). Show forbearance in the moment of rage, and pardon in spite of authority; the eventual end will then be in your favour.
ai.seo_question: What are the key virtues of anger management and forgiveness in Shia ethics?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (AS) addresses al-Harith al-Hamdani, offering a concise guide to ethical leadership and personal character by linking emotional regulation with political magnanimity. This advice emphasizes that true strength lies not in asserting dominance but in exercising self-restraint and forgiveness when one has the capacity to do so, a virtue highly prized in Shia ethics as a path to divine favor and ultimate success (al-'aqibah).
